headline: Executive order sets the order of officials who would lead the Department of Health and Human Services if top leaders cannot serve.
what_it_does: This order lists which officials at the Department of Health and Human Services would step in to act as Secretary if the Secretary and other top leaders die, resign, or are unable to do the job. It is meant to keep the department running without a gap in leadership. No summary was provided, so the specific officials and their order are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Senior officials at the Department of Health and Human Services
who_it_affects.how: It sets which officials would temporarily take on the Secretary's duties, and in what order, if needed.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed December 28, 2001; the exact effective date is not stated in the provided material.
